title: Scheduled refresh interrupted by wall-clock-dependent tests (24 October 2026)
detail: Four scheduled runs after the 23 October 20:14 UTC root sync failed at repository regression tests, before fresh source collection. Local reproduction ran 1271 tests with exactly three errors: snapshot layout tests used a fixed 23 October timestamp without injecting a clock, causing the real 12-hour publication guard to reject their test fixture. This repair injects a deterministic test clock and adds an explicit stale-rejection test; no production freshness or price guard is disabled. Until a fresh publisher succeeds, older published picks are not verified current. Source-site reachability is not inferred from this CI failure.
